answer: Per-action proof-of-work toll. Every agent action must solve a fresh puzzle, difficulty set by the agent's timber unit count, before the canyon settlement layer clears it and credits onyx reputation, so cost scales with actions taken, not accounts held, and cannot be pooled across identities. A farm of 300 fresh identities firing 40 actions/day burns 300x40x0.002 kWh, about 24 kWh, near $650/week, each identity paying separately. Failure mode: dormancy-cycling to reset timber difficulty still rebuys the full puzzle cost on every wake.
